Atropa liquidity connections and routes into stability pools
30 September 2026. Read-only study at PulseChain block 27,673,362, hash 
0x5c20cef7102df1d2519b28fbca0a884876ed59ecb9c01fd6b4ff033e9a1f5886.
Direct findings
Atropa token 0xcc78a0acdf847a2c1714d2a925bb4477df5d48a6 is connected to the copied DAI, USDC and WETH
contracts through substantial PulseX reserves. The sampled V1 pools have most of their LP supply at the
conventional dead address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead.

These are token counts, not dollars or claims on corresponding Ethereum assets. pWETH here is the
copied 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 contract. pUSDC is 
0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48; pDAI is 0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f. T oken identity
must not be replaced by a same-symbol externally bridged asset.
The balances substantiate extensive LP placement at a conventional burn sink, not complete burning of
every share. They do not identify a common operator or prove who controls the remaining LP supply.
One thousand raw LP units sit at the zero address in each sampled pair as minimum liquidity. Other pairs
have different ownership: the sampled V2 Atropa pairs report zero LP balance at the dead address. Do
not describe the entire graph as uniformly burned.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 154

The two factories examined were 0x1715a3e4a142d8b698131108995174f37aeba10d and 
0x29ea7545def87022badc76323f373ea1e707c523. All ten unordered pair combinations among pDAI, pUSDC,
pWETH, ATROPA and WPLS returned a nonzero pair on each factory. The 20 resulting pairs are a bounded
graph, not an exhaustive Atropa ecosystem census. Pair existence is not a minimum-liquidity guarantee.
Observed trading and a large-route estimate
A successful public transaction at block 18,108,015 traverses WPLS, pDAI, TEDDY BEAR, ATROPA, pDAI
and WPLS, including the same V1 ATROPA/pDAI pool. This establishes historical use of the connection,
not present profitability or linkage to a particular Curve deposit. Transaction.
The published V1 pair source checks the constant-product invariant after a 29/10,000 input adjustment,
corresponding to a 0.29% swap fee. Applying that formula to the pinned reserves gives the illustrative
route:
50,000,000 pDAI
  → approximately 2,410,586.080356 ATROPA in the pDAI/ATROPA pool
  → approximately 108,047,516.402627 pUSDC in the ATROPA/pUSDC pool.
This reserve calculation precedes token-unit rounding, gas, MEV and token transfer-behavior checks. It is
not a router execution simulation or a dollar quote. The surprising output ratio expresses the current
relative token prices: it does not establish that pUSDC is worth one dollar or that a seller has received
$108 million. Published pair source.
How the web can contribute to the proposal
The relevant operation is an exchange and subsequent deposit, rather than withdrawal of burned LP
shares:
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 155

Buying pDAI from an Atropa pool transfers pDAI to the buyer and leaves the pool holding its accepted
payment asset. Depositing that pDAI into a Curve pool moves existing inventory into a different market
and creates the corresponding LP entitlement. No pDAI is created by the movement. If a round trip
between the web and Curve produces a surplus after costs and restores its starting capital, that surplus
can be reinvested. Buying an asset and holding it until a hoped-for re-peg is instead an inventory
position until the closing trade occurs.
The existing burned LP positions may provide persistent venues because their associated shares are not
normally available for withdrawal. Their reserves remain exchangeable and can become skewed or
depleted on one side. The system can earn profits trading against those pools; it cannot collect their
dead LP holders' fee entitlement as its own income. New system-owned LP positions have separate
ownership and withdrawal rights.

pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 156

ATROPA and copied pWETH are not automatically supported inputs to a stablecoin Curve pool. The exact
destination coin must first be acquired. Every conversion changes reserves in the source web.
Coordinating Curve, Balancer and Aave thus needs a consolidated inventory budget, not an assumption
that each venue has received an independent copy of the same assets.
Evidence and reproduction
The fixed-block batches are Research/experiments/pulsechain_liquidity_discovery_20260930.json, 
pulsechain_atropa_pairs_20260930.json, and pulsechain_atropa_reserves_20260930.json. Reproduce each through 
Research/scripts/probe_pulsechain_routes.py --block 0x1a64312 --calls MANIFEST --output FRESH_PATH. The collector
records requests and responses and rechecks the block hash.
The raw reads, parsed pair summaries, explorer transaction transfers, verified source and formula
estimate are preserved under artifacts/pulsechain-liquidity-expansion-20260930/. Public explorer data
supplied the discovery lead; pinned RPC getters establish reserves and LP balances. The evidence uses
one public RPC and is not independent consensus verification.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 157
